parent.F105_negative: F60 8/32, TRAIN-only original 12 features 9/32, 20-feature relational 3/32, 20 relational-feature ablation zero change; 16 conflicting identical 20-feature TRAIN label groups. No superiorty qualified.

question: Do different delayed structural credit labels share *exactly the same available policy feature vector*? Quantify the training-label ceiling for 12- and 20-dimensional native scorers, distinguish representational aliasing from irresolvable absence of future information, and measure whether these collisions recur on fresh source-only diagnostics, without training or tuning another policy.

source.note: F105 TRAIN is consumed training context, used here only to reproduce its existing label collision; F106 fresh cohorts become consumed DIAGNOSTIC, NEVER advertised as independent heldout superiority or a new pristine model selector.

label: Use exactly F105's frozen offline TRAIN-only teacher definition, enumerating all source-native F62 legal actions at the six F60 memory checkpoints. From each action, append the next up-to-eight observed public events via unchanged F60 _finish_fixed, then quantify exact terminal source path structural record overlap. Label is sign versus local F60 action. Future target path is used ONLY offline for attribution; no policy gets it.

representations.feature12: Frozen original F62 native 12 action-difference features, exact float value repr keyed; zero parameters added.
representations.feature20: Frozen F105 original 12 plus eight current-prefix graph descriptor action-differences, exact float value repr keyed.
representations.exact_local_visible_state: Canonical per-case SHA256 of prefix native packed memory + current arrived public event + candidate native packed memory. SOURCE-ID memorization upper bound only: not reusable graph representation, and not a new feature proposed for model.
representations.matched_local_state_split: Within same full current memory and event, examine whether any native legal actions have identical 12/20 action features but different offline future-effect label.
representations.F101_path_witness: For selected diagnostic final native memories where terminal query role depth <=6, apply exact frozen F101 source-path explain under 144B and record deletion necessity. No F101 witness is presented to action inference.

metrics.conflicting_labels_per_feature_equivalen: A feature group is conflicting if >1 of labels -1,0,+1 occurs for the exact vector. Report classes, all members, and empirical information ceiling: sum of per-class majority counts / total, plus unavoidable same-feature wrong-label count = total - sum maxima.
metrics.explain_known_label_aliasing: A single identical feature vector cannot deterministically output different labels for its members. The bound is only on reproducing this *particular offline structural potential teacher*, not downstream actual answer accuracy, a proof of missing causal memory information, or an impossibility bound for models with additional non-scalar inputs.
metrics.source_only_F60_vs_original_F105_control: Evaluate unchanged source-native F60, F105 original 12 and original 20 fitted only on F105 original TRAIN; report 16 new diagnostic terminal outcomes with no model fitting on new diagnostics.
metrics.robustness: No exact prior F105 GUARD cases regenerated; immutable old source/prereg Git objects; no paid APIs, CodeX or controller; no source mutation; synthetic source-only.

prereg_decisions.feature12_aliased_if: There is >=1 conflicting label equivalence class in reproduced F105 TRAIN; otherwise NEGATIVE to aliasing for that data.
prereg_decisions.feature20_aliased_if: There is >=1 conflicting label equivalence class in reproduced F105 TRAIN; otherwise NEGATIVE.
prereg_decisions.fresh_replication_if: At least one conflicting 20-feature class in D106-A and one in D106-B; if either lacks one, mark NO_CROSS_MODE_REPLICATION; never retune or add cases.
prereg_decisions.explanation_classification: Even proven exact-feature label aliasing does NOT isolate causation of F105 terminal failure. A full visible native state may resolve differences by source ID memorization, but that does NOT establish reusable structural learning or fix missing future question.
prereg_decisions.confidence: Descriptive exact empirical support bounds only; no random population inference or invented significance.
